messages:
alex_runtime: Heads up — nightly perf run on h100 for gptx-lite shows a p99 +15% for short sequences (<=32). Root traces suggest an increased fraction of CUTLASS-path executions vs Triton since the autotune tweak landed yesterday.

sam_perf: ugh, saw a small blip in prod too around 03:40 UTC. p50 looks fine, p99 moved. Any queued logs? :thinking_face:

alex_runtime: Posting the quick probe output I captured from the canary node:
```
probe_plan: bins=[8,16,32,64]
kernel_route_breakdown:
  triton: hits=1_204 avg_ms=0.88 p99_ms=1.34
  cutlass: hits=812   avg_ms=1.18 p99_ms=2.02

scheduling: batch-smearing enabled, kv_prefetch_threshold=0.2
```

maria_ml: Two quick hypotheses: 1) router's latency estimator for short seqs got regressed and now overestimates Triton throughput -> picks Cutlass; 2) KV-cache churn: more prefix recompute makes Cutlass overhead worse on p99.

ben_infra: Can you paste the decision log for one request? Need to see feature vector used by kernel-decider (hw, seqlen, batch, kv_hot).

alex_runtime: decision log snippet: `hw=h100, seqlen=16, batch=2, kv_hot=false, est_triton_tp=3200tok/s, est_cutlass_tp=3500tok/s, chosen=cutlass, reason=throughput_estimate_delta>threshold`

sam_perf: That est numbers look suspicious for seqlen=16. I remember previous model had est_triton_tp > cutlass for seqlen<=32. Could be a regression in the perf-model weights after the autotune feature add.

maria_ml: Agreed. Quick repro plan: run microbenchmark with forced routing flags to compare p99 across paths, plus a kv-cold vs kv-hot toggle. Use small batch sizes to mimic PLG traffic.

alex_runtime: Running benchmarks now: `./bench_kernel --model gptx-lite --bs=1,2,4 --seq=8,16,32 --kv-hot=0,1 --route=force_triton|force_cutlass --runs=200`

(30s later)
alex_runtime: Paste of condensed results: `seq=16 bs=2 kv_hot=0 -> force_triton p99=1.28ms, force_cutlass p99=2.05ms; observed router: chose cutlass in 73% of samples`

sam_perf: That's a clear mismatch. Router policy learning/regression bug. We should gate the autotune change and revert to previous policy while we investigate.

ben_infra: Can we also get low-level perf counters for one of the forced runs? SM occupancy, l2 hit rate, stall reasons. Cutlass run looked like higher memory stalls when kv_hot=false.

alex_runtime: Got counters (trimmed): `force_triton: sm_occupancy=62% l2_hit=0.83 mem_stall=12% | force_cutlass: sm_occupancy=75% l2_hit=0.67 mem_stall=28%`

maria_ml: That supports extra memory traffic with Cutlass when KV-cache cold -> more prefix recompute -> worse p99. Router shouldn't prefer cutlass in kv_hot=false cases. Looks like the feature "kv_hot" wasn't being considered due to a serialization bug in the decider input vector.

sam_perf: Nice catch. Steps: 1) revert autotune change on canaries (blocking rollout), 2) add unit + integration test to assert kv_hot is part of routing vector, 3) run new perf-model A/B with correct features.

alex_runtime: I'll push a rollback canary PR in 5m and open an issue with the decision logs + attach the bench results. Will mark severity P2 since customer impact is limited to p99 on short-seq workloads.

alex_runtime: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/2187 (revert: autotune/shortseq-weight-change) :arrow_up:

devops-bot: Canary rollback scheduled to cluster canary-3 at 2245001400 UTC. Will report status here.

ben_infra: After rollback, let's also add telemetry: emit a small histogram of route_choice conditioned on kv_hot and seq_bin for future rollouts. That would have caught the drift faster.

maria_ml: I'll take the test + telemetry task. Will file PR after I reproduce the serialization bug locally.

sam_perf: Thanks team. Post-mortem tasks: update rollout checklist to include quick forced-route benchmark for seq bins and kv cold/hot. :white_check_mark:

alex_runtime: One more note — for immediate mitigation we can lower the router's cutlass_threshold for seq<=32 to bias toward Triton until the model is fixed. I'll enqueue that as a short-lived config toggle.

alex_runtime: final status: rollback PR merged to canary, telemetry flag added to canary, bench results uploaded to shared drive (link in issue). Continuing root-cause. :thumbsup:
